question: The distance between the Sun and the Earth is approximately:
solution:
The correct answer is __**150 million km**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The average distance between the Earth and the Sun is about 93 million miles (150 million kilometres).
 
• This distance is also known as one astronomical unit (AU). 
 
• The Earth's orbit around the Sun is elliptical, not a perfect circle, so the distance between the two bodies changes throughout the year:
 
• Perihelion
 
• The point when the Earth is closest to the Sun, which occurs during winter in the northern hemisphere.
 
• At this time, the distance is about 91.4 million miles (147.1 million kilometers).
 
• Aphelion
 
• The point when the Earth is farthest from the Sun, which occurs about six months after perihelion.
 
• At this time, the distance is about 94.5 million miles (152.1 million kilometers). 
 
• Light from the Sun travels at a speed of 186,000 miles (300,000 kilometers) per second, so it takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
